properties.name: gh pr checks --json is unsupported by the gh on the dev box; a poll loop on it exits at once and reads as "CI finished"
properties.statement: Measured 2026-09-11 while watching a PR: `gh pr checks <n> --json ...` is not supported by the apt-installed gh on the dev box, so a wait loop built on it terminated immediately and was read as "all checks finished" — a false all-clear, the exact shape this rule names. What works: read the workflow runs for the HEAD SHA from the REST API (`gh api "repos/<o>/<r>/actions/runs?head_sha=<sha>"`) and wait until none is queued or in progress; or grep the plain-text `gh pr checks` output for `pending`. Matching on the head SHA also survives a force-push, where the old run is cancelled and the new one not yet queued — a window in which "nothing pending" is true and meaningless. Moved here from an agent's machine-local memory file on 2026-09-12 (rule:a-rule-the-project-follows-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-an-agents-memory).
